ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 95% pixel coverage; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to localized surface marks and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black field across the majority of the 2D plane. High-contrast white focal points (approx. 3-8 pixels) distributed in the lower-mid region. High-intensity irregular clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression at the central junction of lobes with an estimated pixel-derived angle of 70-80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude of peaks increases significantly in the distal regions (outer 20% of lobe width).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-straight trajectory along the trailing edge leading to a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly concentrated clusters of high-intensity white pixels located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear streaks; notably a long diagonal mark on the left lobe and multiple smaller vertical/oblique streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy white scarring and textural disruption at the distal tips; multiple linear 'rake' marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced textural irregularity at the lobe tips compared to the relatively smooth linear boundary of the inner trailing edge.
